summary: Master the art of overcoming objections in sales with our comprehensive training course. Boost your confidence and close more deals effectively.
lede: Overcoming objections in sales conversations equips sales and customer-facing professionals to understand buyer resistance and respond constructively. Participants practise clarifying and probing concerns, handling price, timing and competitor comparisons without reacting defensively or defaulting to discounts, and agreeing on clear next steps. The course also covers credibility concerns and internal approvals, helping learners keep conversations consultative while protecting value.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for sales and customer-facing professionals across various sectors.
modules: The Psychology of Objections and Buyer Resistance
Handling Internal Approval and Authority Objections
Objection Handling in Negotiation and Closing Moments
prerequisites: Participants should have basic sales experience and familiarity with sales processes. No specific prerequisites are necessary, but a willingness to engage in role-playing and peer feedback is essential.
